Issue 3126 lists commit 48c44cf73919f327b4f4984767e353efd2dfcceb (PR 3084) as needing an external review. Goal: obtain a real external review by agy of that commit and its current state on develop, and attest on the issue only if clean.
Plan leads (re-verify): one pre-registered fixture exception (payload d0fc52c1...) was never matched because PR 3068 (7da1b6d54) rewrote the payload to 219a885...; the develop test file produces no payload finding; three sibling entries (297e975..., 02d3deac..., 63ef1d3... from PR 3136) also match nothing. The reviewer must confirm the entry is inert (matches no current finding) and that leaving it creates no hole (an inert exception cannot excuse a future finding unless a future payload digest collides: state the collision argument). Do NOT remove entries here: removal is the separate cleanup item.

DECISION GATE: (a) the reviewer returns zero findings and the packet check passes => post the attestation comment (ATTESTATION RULE) and record the comment URL; (b) the reviewer returns any finding => post nothing; classify it: real defect => open a fix PR via a new tracker item (not in this item) or report to the owner; false positive => record the reasoning, rerun the reviewer once with the finding quoted, and still do not attest unless the second run is clean AND you can state why the first finding was wrong; (c) reviewer unavailable or unverifiable output => post nothing, mark this item blocked with the reason.

ATTESTATION RULE (owner decision 2026-10-22, one-time exception to the no-self-attest rule, limited to issues 2806, 2807, 2808, 3125, 3126): the agent may post the attestation comment on the issue ONLY IF a real external reviewer CLI (codex, agy or muse; run as a separate process, never the author agent's own opinion) reviewed the exact commit SHA and returned ZERO findings of any severity. The comment must: start with 'External review: <reviewer>' on its first line; contain a line beginning 'Verified clean'; name the full reviewed commit SHA and the reviewer output file path plus its sha256; contain no line with a bolded severity marker (**Critical**: **High**: **Medium**: **Low**:). ANY finding (even Low, even ambiguous output, reviewer error, timeout or truncated output) means: post nothing, record the finding in this item, open a fix or revert PR if it is a real defect, and leave the issue open for the owner. Never edit or close the issue.

REVIEW PROCEDURE: build a review packet outside the repo (under /Users/joe/Developer/soundness-reviews/<issue>/, never committed) containing the full diff of the commit restricted to soundness paths, the files as they are on current develop, the PR discussion (oracle findings and how each was resolved), and the question: 'Find defects in these soundness-path changes. Report each with file:line and severity, or state explicitly that you found none. Be adversarial.' Run the reviewer CLI read-only against the packet (codex exec / agy / muse; discover the exact non-interactive invocation from its --help), save the FULL raw output to a file, and record the command, reviewer version, output path and sha256 in this item. Verify the reviewer actually saw the diff (it names specific changed lines or functions) before treating 'no findings' as a clean result; a generic 'looks fine' is NOT clean: rerun once with a sharper prompt, then treat as a finding-free-but-unverified result and do NOT attest.

GUARDRAILS (all items): G1 never post a stand-in or any oracle comment; never rerun the oracle; oracle verdict is required on every PR (soundness paths) and no digest may be pre-registered. G2 never weaken a gate, threshold, rule or check; no skip/xfail/quarantine. G3 the primary clone /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox is read-only: use make worktree-create + make agent-write-preflight and absolute worktree paths; stage explicit paths; never git add -A; never git stash; identity Joe Harris, no agent trailers. G4 no CHANGELOG.md entry (curated section is at its 160-line ceiling) and no comments/docstrings in code (make comment-policy-check). G5 commit and PR text for a reader who never saw the session: no item ids, no plan/session labels. G6 never close, label or edit gap issues directly: the daily digest closes them after a valid attestation. G7 no settings/rulesets/secrets/variables writes; no new dependencies or unpinned images. G8 done means merged PR plus verification evidence recorded in the item; an open PR is not done. G9 self-review pass (code review action) before make pr-open; fix Critical and Required findings.
